subject: AuraFin: Additional teams & API keys - sprint plan and term update
messages:
From: Sofia Rojas <sofia.rojas@aurafin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurafin.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling to new teams - timeline & API keys

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and per-token economics looked great. Our product org wants to push Redwood across two additional teams: Fraud Ops (internal tools) and Customer Insights (batch embeddings).

Key asks so we can schedule internal planning:
- Can you confirm how many API keys we can request under our existing contract and any per-key limits?
- Expected lead time to provision 6 extra keys and separate project scopes (prod/test).
- Any term implications if we increase committed capacity for the next quarter (we're looking at +30% token commit).

I've attached a short CSV with the teams and expected call volume. Tom (cc) will own provisioning details from our side.

Appreciate a quick sprint-style plan so we can align with engineering.

Best,
Sofia Rojas
Head of Integrations, AuraFin
So: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: aura-api-key-request.csv (csv)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Rojas <sofia.rojas@aurafin.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurafin.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling to new teams - timeline & API keys

Hi Sofia — great to hear and thanks for the CSV. High level answers below; I’ll follow up with a concrete sprint plan and a draft SOW.

- API keys: We can provision named API keys per project with no hard upper limit on the number of keys; for managed accounts we commonly issue keys per-team/environment. For AuraFin I can provision the 6 keys you requested and tag them as FraudOps-prod/test and Insights-prod/test within 48 business hours after we get the signed addendum.
- Lead time: ~48 business hours for keys once admin access + signed addendum is confirmed. For VPC/private deployments it’s longer (2–3 weeks).
- Term implications: If you increase committed capacity by >=25% we can offer a 6% blended discount on per-token committed pricing for the quarter and extend the current pricing for 90 days. That requires executive approval; I’ll route to my finance lead when you confirm the sizing.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a sprint plan (roles, milestones, rollback) by EOD tomorrow.
2) If you confirm +30% commit, please reply with the estimated new monthly token commit and we’ll attach a short addendum/SOW.
3) Ben (cc) will review quota and quota-guarding rules for the additional apps.

Would you like a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow to align the engineers and finalize the addendum?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 222 3344

Attachment: SOW-AuraFin-Q3.pdf (stub)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Rojas <sofia.rojas@aurafin.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurafin.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AuraFin expansion - sprint plan (draft)

Ben / Lauren — drafting a quick plan so we can execute once AuraFin confirms +30% commit. I included Sofia/Tom for transparency.

Summary: AuraFin wants 2 additional teams (6 keys total), separate project scoping (prod/test), and a potential +30% committed token increase for Q3. They asked for sprint-style milestones and estimated provisioning lead times.

Draft sprint (3 working days):
Day 0 (confirm): Signed addendum + admin contact (Tom).
Day 1: Provision keys (Security tags & project scopes), apply quota policies, create per-key telemetry in Console.
Day 2: Run smoke tests (latency/perf on sample prompts), enable KV-prefix caching for FraudOps.
Day 3: Customer validation, handoff to CS for runbook. Rollback plan: revoke keys and fall back to existing shared key for impacted teams; alert routing configured.

Dependencies / asks for Ben: confirm we can auto-tag keys for AuraFin projects and ensure telemetry segregation. If quota rules need manual intervention, please estimate dev hours (I can get approvals).

Lauren: we’ll need a short addendum (one page) that lists the additional commit and the blended discount terms I mentioned (6% for >=25% bump). Can you draft and include DocuSign placeholders?

I’ll wait for any changes and then send the plan to AuraFin with dates.

—
Mina
From: Sofia Rojas <sofia.rojas@aurafin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurafin.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling to new teams - timeline & API keys

Mina — thanks, this is perfect and actionable. Confirming: AuraFin will move forward with +30% committed tokens for Q3. Tom will share the admin contact and final monthly commit number by EOD tomorrow.

A few follow-ups:
- Please include a DocuSign link for the addendum and a clear field for the activation date (we want keys live no later than Apr 12).
- For the Fraud Ops team, they will need short-lived test keys rotated every 7 days and a permanent prod key with read/write. Can your key provisioning support rotation schedules or should we handle rotation via our in-house KMS?

If you can send the DocuSign link and the finalized sprint schedule we’ll get legal to expedite. Once the SOW is signed we want the keys provisioned and the first smoke run by Apr 12.

Best,
Sofia
